tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Determines whether an AI agent can actually discover and parse a store: whether robots.txt permits each major AI crawler by name, whether a sitemap, llms.txt, product feed or MCP endpoint exists, and whether the catalogue is machine readable. Use this when asked why a store never appears in AI assis

tools.name: check_structured_data
tools.description: Parses every JSON-LD block on a page and reports the schema.org types found, blocks that fail to parse, and whether the types a shopping agent looks for are present. Point it at a product page to check Product and Offer markup, or at a homepage to check Organization and WebSite.

tools.name: audit_product_feed
tools.description: Reads a Shopify store's public products.json and reports what would break a Google Merchant Center or Meta catalogue feed: missing barcodes, absent weights, unpriced or unavailable variants, and thin descriptions. Shopify-only, because products.json is a Shopify endpoint.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "detect_tracking_tags" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
